title: 模型链：用于偏见鲁棒LLM评判器的跨模型审计
summary: 提出Chain-of-Models（CoM）自动审计流程，用第二模型检查第一模型的推理轨迹以减少认知偏见。研究发现审计者身份影响效果，最佳审计者因偏见类型而异，并据此设计偏见特定审计者选择规则，在测试集上达到最高准确率0.884。
summary_en: Proposes Chain-of-Models (CoM), an automated audit pipeline where a second model inspects the first model's reasoning trace to reduce cognitive biases. Finds auditor identity matters and is bias-specific, leading to a per-bias auditor selection rule achieving highest accuracy 0.884.
